report.summary: The HighRequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend traces to failed frontend calls to the ad service. frontend's error spans are concentrated on GET /api/data, its route span 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' and its client span oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (2.6444, 1.3222 and 1.3222 error spans/s at 05:42:41); the same client span was STATUS_CODE_UNSET before and became STATUS_CODE_ERROR in the window ending 05:39:41. Traces and frontend container logs give the exact error '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: Error: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.96.133.83:8080', which is the ClusterIP of Service ad on port 8080. Endpoints 'ad' has no subsets, no pod carries the ad selector, and Deployment ad has 0 ready replicas with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable. The ad pod ad-6478f46d8-lzmd4 was stopped at 05:38:37Z (kubelet 'Stopping container ad' plus ReplicaSet 'Deleted pod') and every replacement attempt from 05:38:43Z to 05:41:27Z was rejected: 'exceeded quota: memory, requested: requests.memory=300Mi, used: requests.memory=6604Mi, limited: requests.memory=1Gi'. ResourceQuota otel-demo/memory holds hard requests.memory=1Gi against a namespace already requesting 6604Mi and was created at 05:38:37Z. Node memory pressure and enabled flagd ad faults were checked and rejected as the mechanism. Gaps: the actor that deleted the pod and the actor that declared the quota are not visible without change history, so this is partially concluded.
